title: Filament Purge / Poop Decorative Flower Vase Set
author: Kopp3D
description:
A set of vases with interchangeable toppers to show off the color combinations of your filament purge (aka poop). No glue, no supports, just print and fill! There are 5 vase sizes and 5 different topper styles and a funnel for easy fill. Each fills about this amount:

XS: 25g

Small: 40g

Medium: 60g

Bottle: 65g

Large: 70g

You can check the amount of waste of your print in Bambu Studio and plan accordingly!

I would recommend cleaning up the stray hairs so they don't stick out of the vase, but you can also just fill the vase and then use something to clip off anything sticking out.

**Edit: All the vases have been updated to be stronger!**

Don't toss your poop - reuse it!
